definitions.explanation: The first academic term of the school year in Japan, typically running from April to July.

examples.japanese: {一学期|いちがっき}が{始|はじ}まった。
{一学期|いちがっき}の{成績|せいせき}はよかった。
examples.english: My grades for the first semester were good.

examples.japanese: {一学期|いちがっき}の{終業式|しゅうぎょうしき}が{終|お}わると、{夏休|なつやす}みが{始|はじ}まる。
examples.english: When the first-semester closing ceremony ends, summer vacation begins.

notes:
JAPANESE SCHOOL TERMS:
Most Japanese schools use a three-term system:
- {一学期|いちがっき}: April to July
- {二学期|にがっき}: September to December
- {三学期|さんがっき}: January to March

Some universities use a two-semester system ({前期|ぜんき}/{後期|こうき}) instead.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一学期|いちがっき}の{成績|せいせき} (first-term grades)
- {一学期|いちがっき}の{終|お}わり (end of the first term)
- {一学期|いちがっき}の{中間|ちゅうかん}テスト (first-term midterm exam)
